name: What the compiler will not decide by rule
description: list every question this experiment's compile cannot answer from its own files, each with the prompt to ask and the shape of a valid answer — so a person or an agent can answer it out of band and the answer goes in git
phrases: what does the compiler need me to decide
what cannot be worked out from the construction file

requires.note: each declares its prompt, its schema and its refusal

returns: each open question with its prompt, its answer schema, and what happens without an answer
notes: THE COMPILE NEVER CALLS A MODEL. A compile that asks one mid-run produces different sheets on different days for reasons nobody recorded. Three steps instead: collect here, answer out of band, pass the answers file back with --answers. C6 ships no resolver; an agent holding the whole lab is the intended one, because a question like 'is this tube prefix already taken' needs a scope a project directory does not have.
